feat(replays): Add delete method for the replay details resource (#39078)

Deletes a replay's recording segments. A replay has a one to many
relationships with its segments. The segment data is stored in blob
storage and has to be removed. Due to the I/O requirements we perform
the operation asynchronously to provide fast API responses and to give
ourselves good retry semantics.

closes https://github.com/getsentry/replay-backend/issues/136

depends https://github.com/getsentry/snuba/pull/3180
depends https://github.com/getsentry/snuba/pull/3181
